lines.ruling: Ruling: representation (dependent bar applied after the worksheet, drop); the case's filer is claimed as a dependent on someone else's return, and i1040gi p. 98, Schedule 1, line 21, allows the deduction only if 'You, or your spouse if filing jointly, aren't claimed as a dependent on someone else's return'. The model wrote that bar into the worksheet line (line 1, project $1,500.00, model $0.00); the project fills the p. 99 worksheet from the interest paid ($2,000 less $500 nonqualified = $1,500 on line 1, line 7 ratio 0.182) and applies the bar in sli.eligible (false) and sli.allowed (zero), so the deduction (sli.deduction, Schedule 1, line 21) is $0.00 on both sides (case branches sli.eligible:false, sli.allowed#1). Same ruling as the earlier class M round on this case (adjudication/sli.md); carry refused only because sli.yaml gained the MFS gate sli.any_if_not_mfs, which this non-MFS case does not take (sli.any_if_not_mfs:true). The model's 0 is not evidence of the worksheet line's value, so it is dropped from the fixture. [dropped]
